reader_summary.headline: Doug Ostrover is the Co-Founder and CEO of Blue Owl Capital.
reader_summary.overview: Doug Ostrover is the Co-Founder and CEO of Blue Owl Capital, a public company borne out of a merger combining Owl Rock Capital and Dyal Capital. Doug is also the CEO and Co-CIO of Owl Rock Capital Partners. The combined Blue Owl manages approximately $53 billion in assets, over 90% of which is in permanent capital vehicles.

key_points.text: Doug is also the CEO and Co-CIO of Owl Rock Capital Partners.
Previously, Doug was one of the founders, and the O, in GSO Capital Partners, which today is Blackstone's alternative credit platform.
He has been involved in leveraged finance working with private equity sponsors for thirty years.
